column3: Close to the Hebrew; “He will be found out” is rendered “when he is found,” and “wealth” as “substance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Lacking of heart” is rendered “lacking sense,” and “one who destroys his own self, he will do it” as “He who would destroy himself does it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A wound and shame” is rendered “Wounds and disgrace.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Jealousy [is] the rage of a man” is rendered “jealousy enrages a man,” and “have compassion” as “spare.”
“He will not lift up the face of any ransom” is rendered “He will not accept any ransom,” and “you will make great a bribe” as “you give many gifts.”
